specs.gpu: Apple A17 Pro 5-core GPU with hardware ray tracing (integrated)
specs.display_type: Liquid Retina IPS LCD (fully laminated, anti-reflective, no ProMotion)
specs.keyboard_notes: NO official Apple keyboard exists for the mini (no Smart Connector). Typing = on-screen or an optional Bluetooth keyboard (~$125 Magic-style case kbd, BBY 19709624 sale) — not priced in

battery.notes: 19.3Wh cell. Apple claims 10h web/video Wi-Fi; users report ~6-8h mixed real-world use.

price.notes: NO keyboard priced in: Apple makes no keyboard for the mini (no Smart Connector) — Bluetooth-keyboard-optional (~$125 case keyboard, BBY 19709624). Tablet $999.97 at BBY (SKU 18588359, grey, verified 2026-11-24; no discount on this tier). Discontinued at apple.com/ca. Cellular variants omitted.

offers.name: Apple iPad mini 8.3" 256GB with Wi-Fi (7th Generation) - Space Grey

reviews.quote: This compact tablet continues to be nearly unrivaled. Pros: fast SoC, optional lots of memory, Pencil and 5G possible, PWM-free display, compact. Cons: stale display-to-surface ratio, refresh rate only 60 Hz, no high-res audio via Bluetooth, only 12 months warranty.

praises: 256GB fits two or three AAA ray-traced games plus a full comic/PDF library — the size most mini owners should buy (r/ipad)
A17 Pro + 8GB RAM runs everything iPadOS has, including Apple Intelligence, at console-port frame rates
Fully laminated 8.3" display with 326ppi — the sharpest small-screen reading experience going
293g disappears in a jacket pocket; USB-C still outputs to monitors for desk use
Clearance pricing makes it the best raw-performance-per-dollar in the iPad family
complaints: No official keyboard — the one accessory the mini will never have
BBY grey-stock 256GB tier ($999.97) sits oddly close to the new A20 Pro mini's $949 launch price
60Hz LCD: every phone under $400 now has 120Hz
Landscape accessories are an afterthought — camera and speakers flip with rotation but the charging port doesn't
Third-party keyboard cases block the Smart Connector-less design awkwardly and add weight the mini exists to avoid

design_philosophy: The sensible middle of the discontinued-but-still-sold A17 Pro mini: same 293g laminated-slate formula as the base tier, with storage sized for the gaming and media libraries this device's console-class GPU actually attracts. Priced at BBY clearance it is now Apple's performance bargain.
